citations.field: 好 headword; formation and meaning discussion; printed p. 1094 / PDF p. 1109; exact bronze quotation occurrence
citations.text: The scan confirms the 好 headword and printed page 1094 (PDF page 1109). The author analyzes early forms as 女 plus 子 and proposes ‘woman’ as the original meaning, then discusses extensions to beauty/goodness and ‘like/love’; these are the author’s historical interpretations, not direct attestation of the proposed original meaning. At the cited bronze example, the scan reads exactly “虘钟：‘用乐好宾。’” The producer correction is verified as raw OCR span [1438,1439), 虐→虘; the following character remains printed simplified 钟. The effective OCR therefore has the exact passage literal 虘钟. The earlier evidence assertion “虘鐘” is incorrect in its second character. This page-specific record reflects the correction already applied by the producer; no further corpus edit was made.

consulted_citations.field: 好 headword, formation and meaning discussion; printed p. 1094 / PDF p. 1109
consulted_citations.text: The scan shows the actual 好 entry. It identifies oracle-bone, bronze, Warring States and Shuowen seal forms as 女 plus 子, and the author calls its original meaning ‘woman’, then describes extension to beauty/goodness and a verbal ‘like/love’ sense. The page cites Shang personal name 婦好 and 《合集》6412. This is the book author’s account, not independent proof of the proposed original sense or a complete semantic chronology. I visually checked the word introducing the bronze example: the scan reads 虘鐘, not the provisional OCR 虐钟. Proposed source-bound OCR correction only; no corpus correction made.
